title: BWD-ARITH1-RECOMPUTE-GAUSSIAN
question: Is storing exact forward Gaussian response G=exp(-Q/2) in FP32 and loading in blend_backward_cu cheaper than recomputing expf, after real memory traffic, buffer, production integration, and full-iteration costs?
hypothesis: HYPOTHESIZED_DROP: store+load traffic (8*N_valid_G bytes) exceeds the O20-removable expf cost, making exact reuse net-negative on A100.

variants.R1: exact forward FP32 cache + backward load (THE CANDIDATE)
variants.R2: cache write-only diagnostic (forward writes, backward recomputes)
variants.R3: load-only synthetic diagnostic (prefilled cache, backward loads)

gates.forward_gate: bit-identical forward output R1 vs R0

no_rescue_rule: If exact FP32 reuse fails on memory/traffic, STOP. No FP16/BF16/quant/selective/compressed/approximate.
traffic_prescreen_threshold: If ideal store+load > 1.5x O20-removable, flag TRAFFIC_RISK_HIGH but continue to bounded diagnostic unless buffer infeasible.
